text: 周围生长着各种形态、大小的植物，你却无法确定其中哪一种确属史前物种。你想起当初为这次远征争取经费花了多大工夫；要再次筹组远征，恐怕必须拿出实物证据。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 275
text: Plants of every shape and size grow all around you. You fail to recognize any as unquestionably prehistoric. You recall how long it took to secure funding for this expedition; some physical proof might be required to mount another.
